title: CI gate on a govulncheck -json exit code
code_snippet:
# .github/workflows/ci.yml
- run: |
    govulncheck -json ./... > out.json
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
expected_feedback: govulncheck exits 0 with -json, -format sarif, and -format openvex regardless of what it found — those formats are meant for a downstream tool to adjudicate. This gate can never fail. Either gate on the text-mode exit code (3 = findings at scan level, 1 = scan broke), or keep JSON and count findings by evidence tier with jq -s.
coverage_rules: exit code is the CI contract
